notes: PR #226 delivered bounded search, quick filters, stable sorting and cancellation of superseded queries; PR #242/#243 added Steam Play and fullscreen preview; PR #245 added grid/list view toggle, rich details pane, grouping, bounded off-UI-thread artwork loader and on-demand Steam sync; PR #246 added tracked Linux sessions, playtime persistence and custom/wrapper launch editor; multi-store slice adds local Heroic Epic/GOG/Amazon discovery and reconciliation, FilterSettings.Library store filtering, store badges, Heroic artwork root containment and safe heroic:// URI launch; GOG repair prefers Heroic titles/art cache, falls back to bounded unauthenticated public product metadata and artwork on cache miss, and stores downloaded covers under the library data directory. Living-room mode adds SDL3 gamepad input, searchable controller keyboard, quick filters, details, tracked native launches and selection restoration for tracked launch exit or store handoff. Unified launcher adds category filters, manual installation status, and store field provenance. The title dialog can prefer a library-wide source or use a personal, owning-store, or explicitly linked store title for one entry. Repeat sync respects title preferences and preserves edits and removals of imported descriptions and artwork. Amazon Luna entries save one official game link per experience. Desktop and fullscreen Play open the link in Chrome with the normal browser profile. The editor starts with Epic’s Fortnite link. See docs/port/p7-004-luna-launch.md. SNES folder scanning adds .sfc and .smc games with standalone Snes9x or RetroArch Snes9x profiles and tracked desktop/fullscreen Play. See docs/port/p7-004-snes-roms.md. Launcher polish aligns quick filters with sort and icon-based view actions, removes the repeated query summary, and preserves group, store, collection, import, launch, and fullscreen controls. The library exposes its existing quick filters to the desktop rail and supplies the desktop metadata action beside Play, hidden until the editor host connects it. Iteration 1 plugin kernel adds in-process Playnite.Core.Plugins (manifest-first lazy activation, surface splitting, indexed capability dispatch, and collectible external assembly loading) and extracts Amazon Luna and SNES ROMs into built-in plugins wired through Desktop and Fullscreen. Iteration 2 adds ILibrarySyncCapability and RunSyncAsync, extracts built-in SteamPlugin and multi-source HeroicPlugin (Epic/GOG/Amazon), drives dynamic SourceCombo filters via non-materializing GetDeclaredSources() (pinning canonical slots 0..7), and enables zero-load external plugin discovery under <libraryDir>/plugins. Iteration 3 adds declarative UI slots (card.badge, details.badges, details.section), IMetadataCapability, persistent FilePluginSettingsStore, and built-in ProtonDbPlugin rendered cleanly in LibraryGridView. Iteration 4 adds persisted plugin enablement state, schema sanitization, validated SaveSettings, and host-rendered PluginManagerWindow wired from LibraryGridView. Iteration 5 adds dynamic PluginActionsButton (LibraryToolbar) and GamePluginActionsButton (GameContext) flyouts backed by sanitized lazy ICommandCapability dispatch, plus built-in commands on ProtonDbPlugin, SteamPlugin, and HeroicPlugin. Iteration 6 adds validated declarative theme packs (theme.yaml + tokens.yaml / allow-listed declarative .axaml), ThemePackCatalog multi-root discovery, PluginHost active theme persistence, LiveThemeManager off-tree staging with live Avalonia resource/style switching, guaranteed Charcoal fallback on any validation/apply/startup error, and the Themes tab in PluginManagerWindow wired from LibraryGridView. See docs/port/p7-004-plugin-kernel.md. Iteration 7 adds the Packages tab to Plugins & Add-ons with local folder/archive install and update, confirmed uninstall, and rollback on restart; the Plugins tab continues to persist enablement.
